message:
I remember one night when the power went out unexpectedly. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and some old-school board games from the shelf, and my family and I gathered around the dining table. It felt so refreshing to unplug and reconnect over some friendly competition, laughing and reminiscing about our favorite game nights from years past. 

We even dug out a few snacks from the pantry that normally get overlooked. Who knew a little darkness could spark such low-tech fun? 

It was a delightful reminder that sometimes the best moments come from simple pleasures. Have you ever had a blackout that turned into a memorable night? I’d love to hear your tips on making the most of those unexpected moments! 😊
